criteria.text: managed SKILL.md file is source of truth; DB row can be stale after PUT /opencode/skills/:name; scheduled apply→measure→revert must restore the original on-disk bytes/body rather than stale DB content.
criteria.test_id: issue-1082-c1: DB/file divergence restores the original on-disk bytes through apply, measure, and revert
issue-1082-c2: sandboxed PUT then proposal approve and measure/revert restores the HTTP-visible SKILL.md bytes
issue-1082-c3: revert preserves custom frontmatter byte-for-byte
issue-1082-c4: an existing file with an empty body is restored rather than treated as missing
issue-1082-c5: revert preserves trailing whitespace byte-for-byte
issue-1082-c6: a missing managed file falls back to the DB body and recreates it on revert
issue-1082-c7: an unsafe proposed body is rejected without mutating DB, file, or proposal lifecycle
